SYNTHETIC — created for an internship demonstration. Not real firm or client data.

Recorded-style responses for the Confluence, Jira and SharePoint connector contract tests
(M12c). They follow the documented shapes of Confluence Cloud REST v2, Jira Cloud REST v3
(issue search) and Microsoft Graph v1.0 (drive delta), but they were WRITTEN for this
project, not recorded from a live tenant: no live Confluence, Jira or SharePoint was used.
All content is fictional ("Example & Associates, Chartered Accountants") and describes
internal firm procedures only. `{base}` is replaced by the mock server's address.
Served by scripts/mock_saas_server.py.
